title: Binary matroid conjecture for matroids with cycle systems
statement: Let $M$ be a matroid admitting a **cycle system**, meaning a cycle-system structure as defined in the source. **Binary matroid conjecture.** Every matroid with a cycle system is binary. The source notes that all known examples admitting cycle systems are regular and relates cycle systems to the underlying circuit space. Whether nonbinary examples exist remains open.
source_name: Scott Corry, Anton Dochtermann, Solís McClain, David Perkinson and Lixing Yi, “Cycle systems, coparking functions, and h-vectors of matroids”, arXiv:2509.11460 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.11460

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2025).
